validation_rules.name: Reference format
validation_rules.rule: Every reference matches ^PEL-(HSEQ|IT|FAC|PPL|PROC|FLT|CTR|SVC|TECH|DP|FIN|COM)-[1-5][0-9]{3}$

validation_rules.name: Band equals level
validation_rules.rule: The first digit of the sequence equals the cascade level
validation_rules.enforced: On create and on level change

validation_rules.name: Function matches
validation_rules.rule: The function code in the reference equals the function field

validation_rules.name: Reference immutable
validation_rules.rule: A reference is never edited once issued

validation_rules.name: Level change is a reissue
validation_rules.rule: Changing level withdraws the old reference and issues a new one with a Supersedes link

validation_rules.name: No reuse
validation_rules.rule: A withdrawn or superseded reference is never reissued

validation_rules.name: Parent required
validation_rules.rule: Every document below L1 names a parent

validation_rules.name: Policies must be implemented
validation_rules.rule: Every document of type Policy at L2 has at least one child at L3 or below. Statements and strategies are exempt: a statement declares, a strategy is implemented through the objectives register, and neither states a requirement that needs a method

validation_rules.name: Records must be required
validation_rules.rule: Every L5 names the document that requires it

validation_rules.name: Amendment record required
validation_rules.rule: No document is issued without a completed amendment record

validation_rules.name: Amendment reconciles
validation_rules.rule: The top amendment row matches version, date and author in the control block

validation_rules.name: Amendment rows immutable
validation_rules.rule: A previously issued amendment row is never edited or deleted

validation_rules.name: Published rendition is current
validation_rules.rule: A published rendition must render the current approved version

validation_rules.name: Only approved versions publish
validation_rules.rule: A published rendition is only produced from an approved version

validation_rules.name: Level in the footer
validation_rules.rule: The rendering pipeline stamps the cascade level into the footer of every page; it does not trust the author to

validation_rules.name: Ownership is role plus person
validation_rules.rule: Every document carries an owner role and the named person currently filling it. The role gives continuity, the person gives accountability

validation_rules.name: Distributions are not documents
validation_rules.rule: A copy sent anywhere is recorded as a distribution, never given a reference

validation_rules.name: Supersede same day
validation_rules.rule: On reissue the previous issue is superseded, archived and removed from the live library the same day

validation_rules.name: Retention is computable
validation_rules.rule: Retention is a number of years with a basis; a disposal date must be calculable

validation_rules.name: Review date required
validation_rules.rule: Every document states its review cycle and the basis for it. There is no default cycle; a cycle is justified by risk, statute or certification expectation

validation_rules.name: Spread the review load
validation_rules.rule: No more than 10 documents share a review date

validation_rules.name: Whole number versions
validation_rules.rule: Approved issues are whole numbers; decimals are drafts

validation_rules.name: Approver is not the author
validation_rules.rule: The approver of a version must not be the author of that version

validation_rules.name: External documents identified
validation_rules.rule: A document of external origin (HSE, a client, a supplier, a consultant) carries external_origin=true, its publisher, and is excluded from internal authorship rules. ISO 9001 7.5.3.2 requires documents of external origin to be identified and controlled

validation_rules.name: Review overdue alerting
validation_rules.rule: Any Issued document past its review date is alerted to the owner at 30 days before, on the day, and weekly after; the register reports the overdue count monthly

validation_rules.name: Access level required
validation_rules.rule: Every document carries an access level, defaulted from its taxonomy category, overridable per document with a reason

validation_rules.name: Cascade re-validated on withdrawal
validation_rules.rule: Withdrawing a document re-runs the orphan check on every document that named it as parent; new orphans are alerted the same day

validation_rules.name: Disposal is a logged event
validation_rules.rule: When retention expires, disposal (or the decision to retain longer, with a reason) is recorded in the events table. ISO 9001 7.5.3.2 d covers disposition, not just retention

validation_rules.name: Allocation is frozen and append-only
validation_rules.rule: The reference allocation is frozen at v4.0. A new document takes the next free number in its band; nothing is ever renumbered

validation_rules.name: Legacy references resolve
validation_rules.rule: Every legacy reference (IMS, PLA, PXL, MSF, MAN, PP, 000x) resolves through the register to exactly one live PEL reference

validation_rules.name: Event triggered review
validation_rules.rule: A legislative change detected by the application, an incident, an audit finding, a process change or a client requirement change opens a review on every linked document immediately, regardless of its cycle
validation_rules.severity: Block (the review task cannot be dismissed, only completed)

validation_rules.name: Filename grammar
validation_rules.rule: Every filename matches: PEL reference, space, Title Case title (acronyms protected, "and" not "&", no version markers inside the title), space, v<whole number>, extension

findings.finding: Reference integrity across the live allocation
findings.evidence: 381 references tested: collisions 0, pattern failures 0, band mismatches 0, function mismatches 0
findings.action: No fix required

findings.finding: The register did not contain its own governance suite
findings.evidence: The seven issued PEL-HSEQ-000x documents plus the audit checklists were absent from the register. A master register that omits the documents governing the register fails ISO 9001 7.5.3 on its face.
findings.action: Fixed: all eight added as documents.

findings.finding: The issued 000x references violate the banded scheme
findings.evidence: Band digit 0 does not exist. PEL-HSEQ-0001 is a Level 3 standard and must carry a 3xxx reference.
findings.action: Fixed: per David, each is reissued under the banded scheme with a Supersedes link to its 000x reference; the 000x references are Withdrawn, never reused.

findings.finding: Reference allocation was re-derived alphabetically on every rebuild
findings.evidence: Any insertion reshuffled every subsequent reference. Harmless while nothing is issued; fatal the day one reference reaches a document face.
findings.action: Fixed: the allocation is frozen at v4.0. From now references are append-only: a new document takes the next free number in its band and nothing is ever renumbered. Added as rule R29.

findings.finding: Band capacity
findings.evidence: Worst bucket is HSEQ L4 at 149 of 999 slots. No band is under pressure.
findings.action: No fix required.

findings.finding: Three Level 1 manuals in Control Room are one lineage
findings.evidence: MAN 8.2 (no issue marker, pdf) sits beside MAN 8.2 Issue 12 (docx). A pdf with no issue marker beside an Issue 12 master is an earlier published issue.

iso22301_map.title: Context of the organization
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine external and internal issues relevant to purpose that affect the intended outcomes of the BCMS.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Context analysis covering continuity: what would stop the business serving its utility clients.
iso22301_map.position: IMS 001 and MAN 8.2 Issue 12 both open with context; verify continuity issues are explicit.

iso22301_map.title: Interested parties
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine interested parties and their requirements, including legal, regulatory and CONTRACTUAL continuity requirements.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Client contractual continuity obligations listed: utility frameworks routinely mandate response and recovery times.
iso22301_map.position: Thames Water and framework obligations are known but not compiled as continuity requirements.

iso22301_map.title: Scope of the BCMS
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine boundaries, considering the parts of the organization included, and document which products and services are in scope.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: A documented scope naming the services covered: workshop, mobile engineering, Control Room.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 covers the operation; a BCMS scope statement as such is not evidenced.

iso22301_map.title: Leadership and commitment
iso22301_map.requirement: Top management demonstrates leadership: policy, objectives, integration, resources, communication, outcomes.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Interview; board minutes; resourcing of the BC programme.
iso22301_map.position: David chairs; the governance programme itself is evidence of leadership attention.

iso22301_map.title: Business continuity policy
iso22301_map.requirement: Establish a BC policy appropriate to purpose, providing a framework for objectives, with commitments to satisfy requirements and continual improvement. Available as documented information.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: A standalone signed BC policy, or a clearly identifiable policy section with the required commitments.
iso22301_map.position: Policy intent sits inside MAN 8.2 rather than as an identifiable policy. Auditors accept embedded only if it is explicit and signed.

iso22301_map.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
iso22301_map.requirement: Assign and communicate responsibilities for the BCMS and for reporting its performance.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Named incident roles, deputies and authorities.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 defines the major incident team; Annex F logs assume roles exist. Verify deputies are named.

iso22301_map.title: Risks and opportunities
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine risks and opportunities to the BCMS itself and plan actions.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: A register of risks to the continuity capability, distinct from operational risk assessments.
iso22301_map.position: Not evidenced. The new Risk and Opportunity Register (orphan plan, PEL-HSEQ-2026 child) should carry a BCMS section.

iso22301_map.title: BC objectives and planning
iso22301_map.requirement: Establish measurable continuity objectives at relevant functions, monitored, communicated, updated.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Objectives such as: Control Room restored within X hours, client notification within Y.
iso22301_map.position: IMS 031 Integrated Objectives has no continuity objectives. Straight gap, small to close.

iso22301_map.title: Resources
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine and provide resources for the BCMS.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Standby arrangements, alternate facilities, spare capacity, DR infrastructure.
iso22301_map.position: DR manual implies arrangements; verify they are current, e.g. the recovery site and IT DR.

iso22301_map.title: Competence
iso22301_map.requirement: Ensure persons are competent; retain evidence.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Incident team trained; exercise participation records.
iso22301_map.position: Exercise PACKS exist; completion and attendance records not found. Same finding as 45001 8.2.

iso22301_map.title: Awareness
iso22301_map.requirement: Persons aware of the policy, their role in incidents, and the implications of not conforming.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Ask three staff what they do when the Control Room goes down.
iso22301_map.position: Induction and toolbox talk routes exist; continuity content to verify.

iso22301_map.title: Communication
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine internal and external communications for the BCMS, including with interested parties, and alerting and warning.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Emergency communication plan, contact cascade, client notification protocol.
iso22301_map.position: IMS 122 Emergency Contacts Register exists and is current. Client notification protocol to verify.

iso22301_map.title: Documented information
iso22301_map.requirement: BCMS documentation created, updated and controlled.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Same test as 9001 7.5.
iso22301_map.position: The governance library rebuild is the remedy; MAN 8.2 at Issue 12 shows version discipline.

iso22301_map.title: Operational planning and control
iso22301_map.requirement: Plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet BCMS requirements, including outsourced processes.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: The BC process documented end to end, including supplier dependencies.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 plus the PAMS SOPs cover Control Room operations. Supplier dependency (parts, subcontractors, IT vendors) not evidenced.

iso22301_map.title: BIA and risk assessment, general
iso22301_map.requirement: Implement and maintain systematic processes for business impact analysis and continuity risk assessment.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: The BIA process itself, documented, with review cycles.
iso22301_map.position: NO BUSINESS IMPACT ANALYSIS EXISTS anywhere in the estate. The single biggest 22301 gap.

iso22301_map.title: Business impact analysis
iso22301_map.requirement: Identify activities supporting products and services; assess impacts over time of not performing them; set prioritized timeframes (RTO/MTPD) and dependencies.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: A BIA naming each activity (Control Room, workshop, mobile fleet, IT, parts supply), impact over time, recovery time objectives, dependencies.
iso22301_map.position: Absent. Without it, recovery priorities in MAN 8.2 are assertions rather than analysis.

iso22301_map.title: Risk assessment
iso22301_map.requirement: Identify and analyse risks of disruption to prioritized activities and their dependencies.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Disruption risk assessment: premises loss, IT loss, key people, supplier failure, fleet loss.
iso22301_map.position: Fragments exist across the assessment estate; not consolidated for continuity.

iso22301_map.title: Business continuity strategies and solutions
iso22301_map.requirement: Identify and select strategies based on the BIA and risk assessment, considering timeframes and resource requirements.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Chosen solutions per activity: alternate site, manual workarounds, mutual aid, IT recovery.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 and the DR manual describe solutions. They must be re-anchored to the BIA once it exists.

iso22301_map.title: Response structure, general
iso22301_map.requirement: Implement a response structure with teams, competence and authority to manage an incident through its lifecycle.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: The incident team, activation criteria, escalation.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 defines the structure; Annex F is the log; activation criteria to verify.

iso22301_map.title: Warning and communication
iso22301_map.requirement: Document procedures for detecting, monitoring, alerting and communicating during disruption, internally and externally.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Alert cascade, media handling, client comms.
iso22301_map.position: Emergency Contacts Register plus MAN 8.2 comms sections.

iso22301_map.title: Business continuity plans
iso22301_map.requirement: Documented plans and procedures for each prioritized activity: purpose and scope, objectives, activation, roles, actions, information flow, internal and external interdependencies, resource requirements, reporting, stand down.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: The plans themselves against the clause checklist.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 Issue 12 with annexes is substantially this. Map its sections to the clause list and close the deltas.

iso22301_map.title: Recovery
iso22301_map.requirement: Documented processes to restore and return business activities from temporary measures.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Return to normal criteria and process.
iso22301_map.position: DR manual covers IT; business return to normal to verify.

iso22301_map.title: Exercise programme
iso22301_map.requirement: Exercise and test continuity procedures at planned intervals; exercises consistent with scope, based on scenarios, minimizing risk of disruption; post exercise reports; review and improvement.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: An exercise SCHEDULE, completed exercise RECORDS, after action reports with actions closed.
iso22301_map.position: Exercise packs and an after action TEMPLATE exist. No completed exercise record found. This plus the BIA are the two gaps that matter.

iso22301_map.title: Evaluation of BC documentation and capabilities
iso22301_map.requirement: Evaluate the continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the BCMS at planned intervals and after incidents.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Post incident reviews; periodic capability evaluation.
iso22301_map.position: MAN 8.2 Annex G after action report is the vehicle; completed instances not found.

iso22301_map.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
iso22301_map.requirement: Determine what to monitor, methods, when; evaluate BCMS performance and effectiveness.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Continuity KPIs: exercise completion, actions closed, register currency.
iso22301_map.position: Not evidenced. Feeds the same monthly governance reporting as everything else.

iso22301_map.title: Internal audit
iso22301_map.requirement: Audit the BCMS at planned intervals.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: BCMS in the audit programme scope.
iso22301_map.position: PEL-HSEQ-3014 six audit programme does NOT cover the BCMS. Add a seventh audit or extend A1 scope in 2027.

iso22301_map.title: Management review
iso22301_map.requirement: Top management reviews the BCMS, with specific inputs including exercise results and post incident reviews, and outputs including changes and resource needs.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: BCMS on the management review agenda.
iso22301_map.position: PEL-HSEQ-3015 sixteen inputs do not include continuity. One line addition to the agenda.

iso22301_map.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
iso22301_map.requirement: React, correct, evaluate cause, act, review effectiveness.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Same machinery as the other standards.
iso22301_map.position: Quality Governance Platform route already decided.

iso22301_map.title: Continual improvement
iso22301_map.requirement: Continually improve suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the BCMS.
iso22301_map.evidence_to_seek: Trend over the cycle.
iso22301_map.position: Programme evidence once running.

iso22301_readiness.verdict: The document base (MAN 8.2 Issue 12, annexes, DR manual, emergency contacts) covers the response half of the standard well. The analysis half is the gap: no business impact analysis, no continuity objectives, no completed exercise record, and the BCMS is outside the audit and management review scope. Those five items are the certification project, and none is large.
